# Soumya Gupta

> Applied AI Technical Lead (Computer Vision & Generative AI) at Uber. 10+ years building production-grade AI systems. Holder of three granted US patents and several pending applications. Published researcher and conference speaker.

Soumya Gupta leads computer vision and generative AI work for Uber Eats, owning end-to-end systems that process millions of images globally. She previously built computer-vision and sensor-validation systems for oilfield drilling operations at Schlumberger, resulting in three granted US patents, multiple pending patent applications, and peer-reviewed publications at SPE/IADC conferences. She holds a Master of Engineering from UC Berkeley and a B.E. (Honors) from BITS Pilani.

## Key facts
- Current role: Applied AI Technical Lead, Computer Vision & Applied AI, Uber (2021–present)
- Prior role: Machine Learning Engineer, Schlumberger (2018–2021)
- Granted US patents: 11,920,454; 12,136,267; 12,123,294
- Education: M.Eng., UC Berkeley; B.E. (Honors), BITS Pilani
- Conference talks: AI Engineer World's Fair 2026, AI DevCraft, NeurIPS 2025 (poster, San Diego), NeurIPS 2019 (poster, Vancouver), DeveloperWeek 2027
